Had a contact email, billing inquiries email, and tech support email. They asked me to remit payment to 9535 Forest Lane, Suite 114J, Dallas, TX 75243. They asked me to pay by check or ACH. The invoice looked very realistic, but thankfully I knew that we don't use any services like that.

I saw an ad on facebook for a women’s “oversized cotton gauze” shirt. I ordered 2 of them for $39.58 USD total. I received several suspicious looking tracking emails before and after I received a package containing 2 shirts that were not at all as the ad described— way too small and of far inferior quality.
I immediately contacted their support@flowarmth.com website to request return instructions and a full refund. After MANY emails back and forth, they have still failed to provide any return information and have offered me varying dollar amounts for “compensation for my troubles”, but less than half of what I paid them. I keep refusing those offers and requesting return information and a full refund, but with no response other than an apology and an offer of a few dollars, which they would probably never send even if I agreed to it.
